- UniverLab: open computational laboratory. Mission motto: "We are
the eyes of the universe opening after a long sleep. Our work is to
create, care, and understand." It's the founder's lab, operating on
three levels: philosophy (Pensamiento Cósmico, manifesto), brand/
gitkit, ghscaff, cadspec, demostage, plus astro-denoise research (
U-Net denoising astronomy), skills registry, workflows reusable CI,

where free software, writing and image-making are treated as one
continuous practice. Its project node carries the lab's motto as its
We are the eyes of the universe opening after a long sleep. Our
work is to create, care, and understand.
There is a body of work called
"Pensamiento Cósmico: filosofía para el hoy y heurística de
. Its argument: the human is a dissipative island inside a sandbox
that is studying itself; the other is another instance of the same
cosmos (the ellipse, not the circle); ethics is a heuristic, not a
deduction from physics ("the draft of nihilism": how many people live
better because you exist); interplanetary continuity is a species-
scale cooperation problem, with partial success accepted. The
org, intelligence holds decisions, roadmap via announcements API.

A set of Rust CLIs and services, each a real tool rather than a demo:
— MCP server + TUI that orchestrates AI agent
accent, a magic-lantern home screen projecting the engraved mark, a
wax-seal garnet emphasis colour, Old Standard TT / EB Garamond /
Sometype Mono, and a Da Vinci frieze footer. Bilingual EN/ES (English
is the source of truth for copy). Experiments keep their own
palettes; the lab only adds a vintage nudge and a shared frame.
The site also treats agents as first-class visitors:
markdown negotiation, API catalogue, WebMCP, a remote MCP endpoint
and a server card. (One open wound: Cloudflare's bot challenge
returns 403 to datacenter IPs, which partly defeats that surface.)
The lab is its own factory: specs in English, canopy graphs with
model quotas with fallback cascades, deterministic gates (i18n
parity, jest, build, SEO), PRs to
roadmap served by the announcements API rather than a ROADMAP.md.

UL1 — ghscaff: self-update replaces the running binary instead of
This loop's workdir is the UniverLab workspace, not one repo. Every file you
touch and every git command you run belongs to `ghscaff` and nothing else.
Leave `gitkit`, `texforge` and every other directory untouched — another
loop is writing to `texforge` right now.
ghscaff's updater shells out to the public install script, which always
writes to `~/.local/bin`. If the user installed ghscaff any other way, that
produces a SECOND binary and the update silently does nothing.
Expected outcome: updating replaces the binary that is running, wherever it
lives — and when that binary came from `cargo install`, ghscaff says so and
hands back the right command instead of writing a copy somewhere else.
